description: Canonical catalog of all models used in the smartsim coupling experiments. Each entry defines the artifact path(s), input/output schema, and optional analytical FLOPs hint for models where torch FlopCounterMode cannot instrument scripted artifacts.

models.description: Three-branch CNN for 3x3 local water-height forecasting. Trained, deployable, smallest local model.
models.notes: Using split_3x3 artifact (two [B,1,3,3] inputs). Also available as flat_contiguous (watercnn_cpu.pt) and split_flat.

models.description: Exact analytical solver for the 3x3 local patch. No learnable parameters; one fp32 buffer (0.25 constant).
models.notes: Using split_flat artifact (two [B,9] inputs); no split_3x3 artifact was exported. Zero trainable parameters; one scalar fp32 buffer (0.25).

models.description: Transformer encoder (3 layers, 4 heads, d_model=64) fused with global MLP. Treats each 3x3 cell pair as a 2-feature token.
models.notes: Scripted with conservative (non-flash) attention for RedisAI compatibility. Known to hang on some CPU login nodes; GPU run is the reference.

models.description: Deliberately oversized 18->4096->...->4096->1 MLP with 12 residual blocks. Export-only benchmark model.
models.notes: width=4096, depth=12 residual blocks. ~419.6M parameters, ~1.56 GiB fp32 payload. Large batch sizes will OOM on CPU.

models.description: Opaque production TorchScript artifact. Autoregressive transformer for 3D flow-field cubes. Input: [B,5,512] packed sequence of 5 history steps; output: [B,2,512] (2 forecast steps).
models.notes: Opaque scripted artifact; FLOPs are analytically estimated from known architecture (~transformer_tbl). FlopCounterMode returns 0 for scripted modules.

models.description: Thin wrapper over the core MMCP artifact that accepts 5 separate [B,512] tensors (one per history step) instead of the packed [B,5,512]. Scripted and compatible with the C++ coupling path.
models.notes: Parameter count includes the entire core model. Identical compute to mmcp_transformer_core.

models.description: Small test-only MLP matching the MMCP output contract. Input: [B,5,512]; output: [B,2,512]. Shared temporal encoder: Linear(512,64)->GELU per step, flatten [B,5,64], then Linear(320,1024)->reshape to [B,2,512]. Not trained; use for compute/bandwidth profiling only.
models.notes: Test-only. Not trained. Payload: ~1.38 MiB (361,536 fp32 params). The MMCP transformer has 177.9M params (~698 MiB) because it is a full encoder-decoder transformer; this MLP replaces that with a simple shared linear projection, which requires orders of magnitude fewer weights to express the same I/O mapping (though obviously without the transformer's representational power).

models.description: As mmcp_test_mlp_m5 but with m=10 history steps. Input: [B,10,512]; output: [B,2,512]. Flatten [B,10,64] -> Linear(640,1024).
models.notes: Test-only. Not trained. Payload: ~2.63 MiB (689,216 fp32 params). Larger decoder (640->1024) vs m=5 because the flattened encoder output grows with m.
